# MEMO: Welcome Flow Revenue Drop — June 2026

**To:** Standup (Thursday)
**From:** Lifecycle Marketing
**Date:** August 2026
**Subject:** Welcome series revenue fell ~49% in June — root cause identified

---

## What Happened

The welcome flow (`flow_welcome`) revenue dropped from a steady ~$17K/month to **$9,034 in June** and **$9,100 in July** — a roughly **$8,800/month shortfall** (~49% decline). Conversions halved from ~330/month to ~167/month.

| Metric | May 2026 | June 2026 | July 2026 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flow entries | 4,057 | 3,784 | 3,820 |
| Emails delivered | 11,765 | 10,973 | 11,078 |
| Open rate | 52% | 52% | 52% |
| Click rate | 11.8% | 11.8% | 11.8% |
| **Conversions** | **330** | **167** | **168** |
| **Revenue** | **$17,823** | **$9,034** | **$9,100** |
| Conversion rate | 8.1% | 4.4% | 4.4% |

Top-of-funnel metrics (entries, deliverability, open rate, click rate) are **unchanged**. The issue is purely in the conversion step — people see the email, click at the same rate, but then don't convert.

---

## Root Cause: Expired Discount Code in Email Hero Image

The welcome email's hero image (`hero_welcome.png`) contains the welcome offer in static image text with **no live-text code fallback** (per the HTML comment: *"hero contains the welcome offer; no alt text, no live-text code fallback"*).

### Timeline

- **2025-06-01:** Discount code `SOLSTICE10` (10% off first order) was created.
- **2025-06-02:** Welcome flow last edited — hero image was designed featuring the `SOLSTICE10` offer.
- **2026-01-10:** Discount code `WELCOME15` (15% off, but restricted to **Midnight & Terra only**) was created.
- **2026-05-31:** `SOLSTICE10` **expired**.
- **June 2026 onward:** The hero image still shows/promotes the old offer, but the code no longer works. The only active first-order code (`WELCOME15`) is restricted to two product lines, and it's not referenced in the email.

### Why It Wasn't Caught

- The welcome email template was last edited on **2025-06-02** — no one updated the hero image when the discount code changed.
- The offer is baked into a static PNG image, not dynamic/live text, so it didn't auto-update with the code system.
- No alt text was provided, so accessibility/QA checks didn't surface the offer text either.

---

## Financial Impact

| Timeframe | Expected revenue (avg of prior 12 months) | Actual | Shortfall |
|---|---|---|---|
| June 2026 | ~$16,884 | $9,034 | **−$7,850** |
| July 2026 | ~$16,884 | $9,100 | **−$7,784** |
| **Total (2 months)** | **~$33,768** | **$18,134** | **−$15,634** |

If not fixed, each additional month costs ~$7,800+ in lost revenue. The welcome flow is one of the highest-converting automated flows, typically generating ~$17K/mo.

---

## Recommended Next Steps

1. **Immediate:** Update the hero image (`hero_welcome.png`) to feature the active `WELCOME15` code (15% off first order on Midnight & Terra). Add proper alt text describing the offer.
2. **Better fix:** Convert the offer to live text in the HTML template so it can be updated without re-rendering images. This also resolves the missing alt-text accessibility issue.
3. **Process fix:** Add a step in the discount-code lifecycle (creation/expiration) to check whether any triggered email/flows reference the old code and schedule a hero image update.
4. **Caveat:** `WELCOME15` is restricted to "Midnight & Terra only" — narrower than the previous general first-order discount. Even after the image update, the conversion rate may not fully recover to 8% unless the offer scope is broadened (within brand guidelines — note: Solstice cannot be %-off discounted per brand policy).

---

## Escalation Note

Per ops policy: the welcome email goes to ~3,800-4,000 new subscribers/month, well under the 100K threshold. The hero image update is a standard creative change within my authority. I recommend Ravi (ecomm) approve the updated creative before the next send cycle.
